name: Becas MAEC-AECID — Programa África-Med Máster
funder: Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores, Unión Europea y Cooperación (MAEUEC) / Agencia Española de Cooperación Internacional para el Desarrollo (AECID)
amount_detail: BOE-B-2026-22411 (convocatoria 2026-2027): importe total 686.400,00 euros; por becario 'una dotación mensual de 2.000,00 euros y seguro de asistencia sanitaria en España durante el periodo de concesión de la beca'. Hasta 30 becas.
covers: Monthly stipend EUR 2,000 + health insurance in Spain, for the period 1 Sept to 31 July. Funds an official, on-campus (presencial) Spanish university master of at most 60 ECTS. Does NOT state tuition is paid separately — the stipend is the benefit named in the BOE extract.
eligibility_verbatim: Beneficiarios: 'Ciudadanía de países de África y Oriente Medio relacionados en el apartado 1.2. de la resolución de la convocatoria, que tengan la condición de personal funcionario o empleado público de carácter fijo, no temporal' (BOE-B-2026-22411). AECID programme page, 2026/2027: 'Personas funcionarias o empleados públicos de carácter fijo, no temporal (incluido el personal del sistema educativo y universitario público), con ciudadanía de los siguientes países de África y Oriente Medio: Angola, Argelia, Cabo Verde, Camerún, Chad, Costa de Marfil, Egipto, Etiopía, Gabón, Ghana, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Guinea Ecuatorial, Irak, Jordania, Kenia, Líbano, Libia, Mali, Marruecos, Mauritania, Mozambique, Namibia, Níger, Nigeria, Palestina, República Democrática del Congo, Senegal, Sudáfrica, Sudán, Tanzania, Túnez y Zimbabue.' Prior-year convocatoria text (Anexo II, 2024-2025) states it identically: 'AFRICA-MED MASTER: Conceder becas a funcionarios o empleados públicos, de carácter fijo no temporal, incluido el sistema educativo y universitario, para la realización de másteres universitarios o propios de carácter presencial en España de 60 créditos ECTS como máximo.'
exclusion_clause_verbatim: 'Ser personal funcionario o empleado público, de carácter fijo, no temporal, de su país.' (AECID Preguntas frecuentes, requisitos AFRICA-MED Máster). Reinforced in the BOE extract: 'que tengan la condición de personal funcionario o empleado público de carácter fijo, no temporal' (BOE-B-2026-22411, Beneficiarios). CONFIRMED: Túnez IS in the country annex, but the employment-status condition is the binding exclusion — private-sector applicants are ineligible regardless of nationality. Two further hard gates from the same FAQ: 'Estar en posesión de la admisión al máster universitario, curso 2026-2027' (admission must already be held when applying) and 'másteres universitarios (oficiales)...de 60 créditos ECTS como máximo' (90- and 120-ECTS masters are excluded).
deadline_2027_intake: 2026-2027 edition (funding 1 Sept 2026 – 31 July 2027): applications 2–15 July 2026, now CLOSED. Plazo defined as '10 días hábiles a contar desde el día siguiente a la publicación del extracto de la convocatoria en el Boletín Oficial del Estado'. The 2027-2028 convocatoria is NOT YET PUBLISHED; on the observed pattern (resolución 29 June 2026, BOE extract early July 2026, window 2–15 July 2026) a Sept-2027 intake call would be expected around late June / early July 2027, but that is a pattern, not a published date — treat as NOT FOUND.
notes: THE MOST IMPORTANT NEGATIVE FINDING IN THIS BLOCK. África-Med is the AECID line that names Tunisia explicitly and is the one most often recommended to Tunisian applicants, but it is a public-servant capacity-building instrument, not a general student scholarship. The candidate (private-sector software engineer, no funcionario status) does not meet the beneficiary definition. Two further constraints even for an eligible person: (a) the master must be 'de hasta 60 créditos ECTS' — this excludes every 90- and 120-ECTS master in the sweep; (b) 'presencial' only — no online/semipresencial; (c) prior admission to the master is required BEFORE applying for the scholarship ('la admisión al máster previo a solicitar la beca'). Sibling lines in the same convocatoria: ÁFRICA-MED ESPAÑOL (same funcionario restriction, Spanish-language masters only) and ÁFRICA-MED INVESTIGA ('a investigadores y profesores de educación universitaria' — research stay, not a master, also not applicable). BDNS 916186.

name: Becas MAEC-AECID — Programa MÁSTER (América Latina y Filipinas)
amount_detail: BOE-B-2025-5706 (2025-2026 edition): 'una dotación mensual de 1.900 euros y seguro de asistencia sanitaria' en España; crédito total '1.981.100,00 euros'; aprox. 90 becas.
covers: Monthly stipend EUR 1,900 + health insurance in Spain, 1 Sept – 31 July, for an official on-campus Spanish university master of at most 60 ECTS.
eligibility_verbatim: BOE-B-2025-5706, Beneficiarios: 'Ciudadanos de Bolivia, Colombia, Cuba, Ecuador, El Salvador, Filipinas, Guatemala, Haití, Honduras, Paraguay, Perú y República Dominicana'. Objeto: 'másteres universitarios (oficiales) de carácter presencial en España de 60 créditos ECTS como máximo, del 1 de septiembre de 2025 al 31 de julio de 2026'. AECID convocatoria page: the programme is for 'empleados públicos y personal integrado en los sistemas públicos' of those countries.
exclusion_clause_verbatim: 'Ciudadanos de Bolivia, Colombia, Cuba, Ecuador, El Salvador, Filipinas, Guatemala, Haití, Honduras, Paraguay, Perú y República Dominicana' (BOE-B-2025-5706, Beneficiarios). Tunisia is not named; the beneficiary class is closed and enumerated. DOUBLE exclusion — nationality AND permanent public-employee status.
deadline_2027_intake: 2025-2026 edition: 'Del 20 de febrero al 6 de marzo de 2025', closing at '13:00:00 horas del registro electrónico de la AECID'. No 2026-2027 or 2027-2028 Programa MÁSTER convocatoria located as of 2026-08-25 — NOT FOUND. Moot for this candidate given the nationality exclusion.
notes: This is the AECID line most often confused with África-Med. It is the LATIN-AMERICA line: Tunisia is not in its enumerated beneficiary list, and it additionally requires permanent public-employee status. Note the wider AECID landing page headline says 'América Latina, África y Asia', which is the umbrella for all lines collectively — the individual convocatoria for Programa MÁSTER is narrower. Do not read the umbrella heading as an eligibility statement. BDNS 814969.

name: Becas MAEC-AECID — Programa Escuela Diplomática (Máster de Formación Permanente en Diplomacia y Relaciones Internacionales)
amount_detail: BOE-B-2026-16321 (2026-2027): 'Cuantía total: 156.420,00 euros'; 'dotación mensual de 1.500 euros'; 'hasta 11 becas'.
covers: Monthly stipend EUR 1,500 to follow the Escuela Diplomática's Máster de Formación Permanente en Diplomacia y Relaciones Internacionales in Madrid.
eligibility_verbatim: BOE-B-2026-16321, Beneficiarios: 'Personas con nacionalidad de países de América Latina, África y Asia'. Objeto: 'Conceder hasta 11 becas para realizar el Máster de Formación Permanente en Diplomacia y Relaciones Internacionales'. AECID 2026-2027 announcement describes the target as 'personas funcionarias y profesionales integradas en sistemas públicos de América Latina, África, Asia y Ucrania'. AECID programme index states: 'Funcionarios o empleados públicos de carácter fijo, no temporal, de países de América Latina, África, Asia y Ucrania'.
exclusion_clause_verbatim: TWO independent bars. (1) Nationality: per AECID's Preguntas frecuentes, Túnez does NOT appear in the Escuela Diplomática country list, although it does appear in the África-Med list — the two lines carry DIFFERENT country annexes and the Diplomática one excludes Tunisia. (2) Employment status: 'Ser personal funcionario o empleado público, de carácter fijo, no temporal, de su país.'
deadline_2027_intake: 2026-2027 edition: applications closed 3 June 2026 (AECID announcement); BOE extract defines the window as '10 días hábiles a contar desde el día siguiente a la publicación'. No 2027-2028 call published as of 2026-08-25 — NOT FOUND.
notes: Off-field for this candidate on two counts beyond eligibility: (1) it funds ONE named programme, a diplomacy master, not a master of the applicant's choosing — none of the nine path codes apply; (2) that programme is a 'Máster de Formación Permanente', i.e. a título propio under RD 822/2021, so it is not an official máster universitario and carries no PhD access. BDNS 906276.

name: Becas de carácter general del Ministerio de Educación ("Becas MEC") — enseñanzas postobligatorias, incl. máster universitario
funder: Ministerio de Educación, Formación Profesional y Deportes — Secretaría de Estado de Educación
amount_detail: Means-tested and componentised. Ministry portal, 'Tipos de becas — Universidad y Enseñanzas Artísticas Superiores: grado y máster', curso 2026/2027: beca de matrícula — 'Comprenderá el importe de los créditos de los que te matricules por primera vez'; 'Por renta familiar: 1.700 €'; 'Por cambio de residencia: 2.700 €'; 'Por excelencia académica: 50 € - 125 €'; plus a cuantía variable distributed by formula, with 'la cuantía variable será la mínima (60 €)' where enrolment is 30-59 credits or thesis-only. (2026-27 rates.)
covers: Tuition (precios públicos) plus income- and residence-linked cash components for official university study including máster universitario.
eligibility_verbatim: Ministry portal becaseducacion.gob.es, 'Universidad y Enseñanzas Artísticas Superiores: grado y máster — Qué necesitas' (requisitos generales): 'Ser español/a o tener la nacionalidad de un estado miembro de la Unión Europea.' For EU nationals: 'tú o tu familia tenéis que residir de forma permanente en España o acreditar un trabajo por cuenta propia o ajena en España' (otherwise only the tuition component). For non-EU nationals: 'puedes tener derecho a beca si eres menor de 18 años o si has obtenido permiso de residencia a 31 de diciembre de 2025.' Also general: 'No haber obtenido un título de nivel igual o superior a los estudios para los que pides la beca.' Master-specific: first year requires enrolment in 'mínimo 60 créditos' (30 with limitations) and 'nota media de 5 puntos en los estudios que dan acceso al máster'.
exclusion_clause_verbatim: 'No es suficiente tener concedida la autorización de estancia.' (becaseducacion.gob.es, requisitos generales, non-EU applicants — immediately following 'puedes tener derecho a beca si eres menor de 18 años o si has obtenido permiso de residencia a 31 de diciembre de 2025.') THIS IS THE DECISIVE CLAUSE. A Tunisian student entering Spain on a study visa holds an 'autorización de estancia por estudios', not a 'permiso de residencia' — expressly declared insufficient. The residence permit must moreover already exist by 31 December of the calendar year BEFORE the course starts, i.e. before the student has arrived.
deadline_2027_intake: 2026-2027 convocatoria (Resolución de 23 de marzo de 2026, BOE-B-2026-9261): 'desde el día 7 de abril de 2026, a las 8,00, hora peninsular, hasta el día 18 de mayo de 2026, a las 15,00, hora peninsular'. The 2027-2028 convocatoria is NOT YET PUBLISHED (NOT FOUND). Note the structural trap even if the candidate somehow qualified: the window closes in MAY, months before a September enrolment, and the residence-permit cut-off is the PRECEDING 31 December.
notes: THE 'WIDELY ASSUMED OPEN' ROUTE THAT IS CLOSED. Two independent bars for this candidate: (1) nationality/residency — Spanish or EU nationality, or a non-EU permiso de residencia already held by 31 Dec of the prior year; a study-stay authorisation is explicitly excluded; (2) SECOND POSSIBLE BAR worth flagging: 'No haber obtenido un título de nivel igual o superior a los estudios para los que pides la beca' — a 300-ECTS 5-year Spanish-equivalent Ingeniería title is MECES level 3 (máster), so if his Tunisian degree were homologated at that level this rule could independently disqualify him from a máster beca. That is a reasoned flag, NOT a ruling — not verified against the convocatoria text. FURTHER: from 2026-27 the competence was transferred to the Generalitat de Catalunya, so applicants whose family domicile is in Catalonia apply to AGAUR's 'Beca general de la Generalitat' instead of this call — relevant because several target programmes are in Barcelona; CONFIRMED on the Ministry's own portal front page: 'as of 2026/27, students with family residences in Catalonia must apply through the corresponding regional authority, as competencies have been transferred to the Generalitat de Cataluña'. Full convocatoria text: BDNS 894743, https://www.infosubvenciones.es/bdnstrans/GE/es/convocatoria/894743

name: Fundación Carolina — Becas de Posgrado (máster) en España
funder: Fundación Carolina (public-private foundation; MAEUEC/AECID plus Spanish corporate patrons)
amount_detail: NOT FOUND at the level of a single figure — Fundación Carolina amounts are set per máster in the annual convocatoria annex. The 2026-2027 call totals '736 becas en todas las áreas de conocimiento', of which '228 becas de posgrado'.
covers: Typically tuition plus travel and a monthly living allowance, set per programme in the convocatoria annex. NOT verified per-programme here.
eligibility_verbatim: Fundación Carolina, Becas de Posgrado: the programme is directed at 'licenciados nacionales y residentes de un país de América Latina, miembro de la Comunidad Iberoamericana de Naciones, o Portugal, con capacidad académica o profesional avalada por un currículum sobresaliente'. Restated on the 2026-2027 convocatoria coverage as: 'las becas de postgrado están dirigidas a la formación en España de licenciados nacionales de un país de América Latina miembro de la Comunidad Iberoamericana de Naciones, o de Portugal'. A further standing requirement is 'no tener la residencia en España'.
exclusion_clause_verbatim: 'licenciados nacionales y residentes de un país de América Latina, miembro de la Comunidad Iberoamericana de Naciones, o Portugal' (fundacioncarolina.es/formacion/postgrado/). Tunisia is not a member of the Comunidad Iberoamericana de Naciones and is not in Latin America or Portugal. A Tunisian citizen is outside the beneficiary class for every Fundación Carolina postgraduate line.
deadline_2027_intake: 2026-2027 call: 'Las fechas de apertura y cierre de la convocatoria de becas de posgrado y estudios institucionales será del 12 de enero al 2 de marzo de 2026'; doctorate/short-stay/mobility '12 de enero ... 9 de abril'. The 2027-2028 call is NOT YET PUBLISHED (NOT FOUND). Moot given the nationality bar.
notes: CLEAN, DOCUMENTED NO — stated flatly because Fundación Carolina is the single most-cited 'study in Spain' scholarship and is routinely recommended to applicants for whom it is legally impossible. Its mandate is Ibero-American, by design and by charter. There is no Tunisia-eligible line, no exception route, and no point spending application effort here. Caveat on precision: the exact 'Requisitos' list was not retrievable as a standalone block from the Fundación's own page (the requisitos live inside the per-programme convocatoria annex); the nationality wording quoted above IS from fundacioncarolina.es. The 'no tener la residencia en España' condition is reported by secondary sources and is UNCONFIRMED against the Fundación's own text — it does not change the verdict.

name: AECID Cooperación Española en Túnez — becas y lectorados (country-level channel)
funder: AECID — Oficina Técnica de Cooperación / Embajada de España en Túnez
amount_detail: Not a separate funding instrument with its own amounts. It is the country channel through which the MAEC-AECID lines reach Tunisian applicants.
covers: Channels the MAEC-AECID becas and lectorados to Tunisia; no independent country scholarship for master's study was found.
eligibility_verbatim: AECID en Túnez: 'Programas de Becas y Lectorados MAEC-AECID' — 'la Cooperación Española contribuye a la capacitación y formación de ciudadanos tunecinos integrados en el sistema público del país, incluido el sistema educativo y universitario, ofreciéndoles la oportunidad de formarse en España.'
exclusion_clause_verbatim: 'ciudadanos tunecinos integrados en el sistema público del país, incluido el sistema educativo y universitario' (AECID en Túnez). This is the COUNTRY-LEVEL RESTATEMENT of the funcionario restriction: Spain's own description of what its cooperation offers Tunisians is public-sector capacity building, not open student scholarships. It independently corroborates the África-Med finding.
deadline_2027_intake: NOT FOUND — no independent Tunisia-specific call. Deadlines follow the MAEC-AECID convocatorias.
notes: Searched specifically for a bilateral Spain–Tunisia scholarship for master's study open to private-sector graduates. NONE FOUND. Tunisia is a priority partner under the 'Plan Director de la Cooperación Española para el Desarrollo Sostenible y la Solidaridad Global 2024-2027', but the instrument that reaches individuals is África-Med, with its funcionario condition. The Spanish Embassy in Tunis publishes a general guide 'Estudiar en las universidades españolas (Túnez)' which, on reading, contains NO Tunisia-specific scholarship — it simply links onward to the AECID becas-y-lectorados page. Separate lead worth passing to the university-scholarships block: secondary reporting mentions Universidad de Jaén offering scholarships specifically for Tunisian nationals covering housing and tuition; this was NOT confirmed on ujaen.es and is recorded here only as an UNVERIFIED lead, not a finding.

name: CSIC — Becas JAE Intro / JAE Intro ICU (introducción a la investigación)
amount_detail: NOT FOUND — no amount stated on any CSIC page reachable during this pass. Volume for 2026: '240 becas JAE INTRO de introducción a la investigación' and '441 becas JAE Intro ICU de introducción a la investigación en 2026'.
covers: An introduction-to-research stipend for a short placement in a CSIC research group. It is NOT tuition or living funding for a master's degree — the master's degree is the context, not the object of the grant.
eligibility_verbatim: NOT FOUND. The CSIC pages reachable in this pass (csic.es 'Formación de personal investigador' and its Máster sub-page) name 'Becas Programa JAE', 'Alianza académica UIMP-CSIC', 'Participación en másteres', 'Trabajo Fin de Máster (TFM)' and 'Prácticas de máster Convenio Universidades-CSIC' but publish no requisitos, no nationality clause and no amounts at that level; the annual convocatoria PDF (sede.csic.gob.es) could not be located — the two URLs tried returned HTTP 404.
exclusion_clause_verbatim: NOT FOUND — do not assume either way. The general pattern for JAE Intro is that the applicant must already be enrolled in a Spanish university grado or máster, which would make it a top-up AFTER admission and funding are secured, not a way to fund the move to Spain. That is stated as a pattern, NOT as a verified rule.
notes: BLOCKER — needs a human. CSIC's own site does not expose the JAE Intro convocatoria requisitos at any URL found; both sede.csic.gob.es paths tried 404'd and the WebSearch budget for this session was exhausted before the convocatoria could be located. What IS established: CSIC's JAE line is an introduction-to-research grant sitting alongside an existing enrolment, so even if open to non-EU nationals it does not solve the primary funding problem (tuition + living costs for a September 2027 master's intake). Relevant to path codes AA/AB/AC/A/B/C because CSIC institutes (e.g. IIIA-CSIC in AI) host such placements. Recommend a human open https://sede.csic.gob.es and the CSIC convocatorias listing to read the requisitos before this is ranked at all.

name: Ministerio de Ciencia, Innovación y Universidades — funding for máster universitario students
funder: Ministerio de Ciencia, Innovación y Universidades
eligibility_verbatim: NOT FOUND — universidades.gob.es returned HTTP 503 on every attempt during this pass (root and two beca paths).
notes: BLOCKER — needs a human. IMPORTANT CONTEXT that limits how much is missing: the Spanish state's general student scholarship for máster universitario is the Ministerio de Educación 'beca de carácter general' already recorded in this file (scholarship_id becas-mec-caracter-general), not a separate Universidades instrument. The Universidades/Ciencia department's individual-facing instruments are predoctoral (FPU, FPI, Ramón y Cajal etc.) and the 'beca de colaboración', which attaches to the FINAL YEAR OF GRADO, not to a máster. So the expected finding is that there is no additional central master's scholarship here — but universidades.gob.es was unreachable (503) so this is recorded as NOT FOUND, not as a negative finding.
